verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a TypeScript framework's ecosystem could ship AI tooling that auto-fixes type errors. The evidence only shows generic 'AI-forward resources and integrations', an AI section of prompts and best practices, and an llms.txt file. None of it documents tooling that automatically resolves type errors surfaced by Angular's type system.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors surfaced by the framework's type system
